identity.summary: Approved logo geometry, source bytes, ownership, and affiliation are unchanged. Cueson 1.0.1, ESO Weave 1.0.1, and Fragcap 1.1.1 advance package versions for guidance changes without identity redesign.

palette.summary: Consumers using generated semantic color roles must repin the rebuilt kit and retain its measured surface-specific values.

typography.summary: Consumers using generated typography bindings must repin the rebuilt kit and its local font declarations.

platform_assets.summary: Consumers may adopt the generated web, Android, Apple, macOS, and Windows asset suites when those targets apply.

web_react.summary: Web and React consumers may adopt the AppFrame and environment contracts when they use those generated surfaces.

egui.summary: Native Rust consumers may regenerate and adopt egui adapter 1.0.1 to receive corrected fine-pointer density while preserving conservative input targets.

documentation.summary: Readers and consumers using generated guidance should repin the rebuilt kit for current instructions, readable integration previews, and the exact-version bundle record.

recovery.summary: Consumers retaining a kit must preserve the delivered checksummed BrandBuilder recovery bytes and canonical immutable package identity.
